title: Clap and groove
goal: Put a clap on 2 and 4 and lock in a syncopated rim with a Euclidean rhythm.
explain: "~ cp ~ cp" divides the bar into four and puts the clap on beats 2 and 4. rim(3,8,2) is a Euclidean rhythm: 3 hits spread as evenly as possible over 8 steps, rotated by 2, which gives a rolling off-grid accent. Euclidean rhythms are a fast way to get grooves that feel human. Keep the rim quiet: it should be felt more than heard.
reference_snippet:
const drums = stack(
  s("bd*4"),
  s("hh*8").gain("[0.25 0.45]*4"),
  s("[~ oh]*4").gain(0.35),
  s("~ cp ~ cp").gain(0.6),
  s("rim(3,8,2)").gain(0.3),
).bank("RolandTR909").swingBy(1/6, 4)
drums
try_prompt: Add a clap on 2 and 4 and a quiet Euclidean rim (3 over 8) to the drums.
